component.name: ser-player
component.summary: A simple video player for playing SER files used for solar, lunar and planetary astronomy-imaging.

description.p: A simple video player for playing SER files used for solar, lunar and planetary astronomy-imaging.
SER Player is a C++ application using the Qt cross-platform framework so that it can be built for Windows, macOS and Linux.

ul.li: Migrated the project to a new maintainer, Cyril Richard, who continues development.
Updated the application to use Qt6, ensuring compatibility with modern operating systems.
